questions.question: The value of (1 + tan 20º + sec 20º) (1 + cot 20º - cosec 20º) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(1 + tan 20° + sec 20°) × (1 + cot 20° - cosec 20°)

**Formula used:**

 
• tan θ = sin θ / cos θ
 
• sec θ = 1 / cos θ
 
• cot θ = cos θ / sin θ
 
• cosec θ = 1 / sin θ

**Calculation:**

Convert everything to sine and cosine:

(1 + tan 20° + sec 20°) = 1 + (sin 20° / cos 20°) + (1 / cos 20°)

⇒ 1 + sin 20°/cos 20° + 1/cos 20° = (cos 20° + sin 20° + 1) / cos 20°

Now, for the second term:

(1 + cot 20° - cosec 20°) = 1 + (cos 20°/sin 20°) - (1/sin 20°)

⇒ 1 + cos 20°/sin 20° - 1/sin 20° = (sin 20° + cos 20° - 1) / sin 20°

Now, multiply the two expressions:

(cos 20° + sin 20° + 1) / cos 20° × (sin 20° + cos 20° - 1) / sin 20°

⇒ ((cos 20° + sin 20° + 1) × (sin 20° + cos 20° - 1)) / (cos 20° × sin 20°)

Now, expand the terms in the numerator:

(cos 20° + sin 20° + 1)(sin 20° + cos 20° - 1) = (cos 20° + sin 20°)² - 1

⇒ (cos 20° + sin 20°)² - 1 = cos² 20° + sin² 20° + 2cos 20°sin 20° - 1

⇒ cos² 20° + sin² 20° = 1 (Pythagoras identity)

⇒ 1 + 2cos 20°sin 20° - 1 = 2cos 20°sin 20°

Now, substitute back:

⇒ (2cos 20°sin 20°) / (cos 20° × sin 20°)

⇒ 2

**∴ The value is 2.**

questions.question: Which part of the nephron collects the initial filtrate from blood?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bowman's capsule**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The filtration process in the Bowman's capsule is highly selective, allowing only certain substances to pass through based on size and charge
 
• The presence of substances in the filtrate that are normally retained in the blood can indicate kidney dysfunction or disease.
 
• The goal of filtration in the kidneys is to remove waste products from the blood while conserving substances that are useful to the body, such as glucose and certain ions

• These nephrons perform the function of filtration of blood and deposition of the urine in the collecting duct.
 
• This urine is later excreted out from the body through the urethral opening.
 
• A Nephron has two main parts - the glomerulus and the renal tubule.
 
• The glomerulus is a tuft of capillaries formed by the afferent arteriole - a fine branch of the
 
• renal artery. Blood from the glomerulus is carried away by an efferent arteriole.
 
• The renal tubule begins with a double-walled cup-like structure called Bowman's capsule, which encloses the glomerulus.

• The Bill seeks to ensure that marriages are based on consent and maturity.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Amendment**
 
 
• The amendment aims to address issues of gender inequality and to promote women's health and education.
 
• Raising the minimum age of marriage is expected to reduce instances of early pregnancies and associated health risks.
 
• It is also expected to provide women with more opportunities for higher education and career advancement.

(a) Light from the sun near the horizon passes thicker layers of air and larger distance in the earth's atmosphere before reaching our eyes.

(b) Near the horizon, most of the blue light and light of shorter wavelengths are scattered away by the particles, and the light that reaches our eyes is of longer wavelengths.

Which of the above statements help(s) us to understand the red colour of the sun at sunrise and sunset?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Both(a) and (b)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Both statements (a) and (b) help us understand the red colour of the sun at sunrise and sunset.
 
• **Statement (a):**
 
 
• **​** When the sun is near the horizon, the sunlight has to travel a longer distance through the Earth's atmosphere compared to when it's overhead.
 
• This longer path means it encounters more atmospheric particles.
 
 
 
• **Statement (b):**
 
 
• As the sunlight passes through these atmospheric particles, shorter wavelengths like blue and violet are scattered more easily.
 
• This scattering is caused by a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering.
 
 
 
• **Red light prevails**:
 
 
• Since the shorter wavelengths are scattered away, the longer wavelengths, like red and orange, are less scattered and reach our eyes directly.
 
• This is why the sun appears red at sunrise and sunset.
 
 
 
• **In essence, the combination of the longer path through the atmosphere and the scattering of shorter wavelengths results in the predominance of red light reaching our eyes, creating the beautiful red hue of the sun at sunrise and sunset.**

questions.question: Out of 118 elements in the Modern Periodic Table, there are _______ naturally occurring elements.
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Out of the 118 elements in the Modern Periodic Table, there are 94 naturally occurring elements.
 
• The remaining elements (from atomic number 95 to 118) have been synthesized artificially in laboratories.
 
• Naturally occurring elements span atomic numbers 1 (Hydrogen) to 94 (Plutonium).
 
• Oxygen (O) is the most abundant element in the Earth’s crust, followed by Silicon (Si) and Aluminium (Al).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Categories of Naturally Occurring Elements:**

 
 
• **Metals**: A majority of naturally occurring elements are metals. These include elements like Iron (Fe), Gold (Au), Silver (Ag), Copper (Cu), and Aluminium (Al).
 
• **Non-metals**: Non-metals include Carbon (C), Nitrogen (N), Oxygen (O), Phosphorus (P), and Sulfur (S).
 
• **Noble Gases**: These inert gases include Helium (He), Neon (Ne), Argon (Ar), Krypton (Kr), Xenon (Xe), and Radon (Rn).
 
 
 
• **Radioactive Elements:**
 
 
• Technetium (Tc) and Promethium (Pm) (atomic numbers 43 and 61, respectively) are notable because they are often considered as not naturally occurring due to their instability, though small amounts have been found in nature.
 
• Uranium (U) and Thorium (Th) are naturally occurring radioactive elements found in Earth’s crust. They are important for nuclear power and energy applications.
 
• Plutonium (Pu), though primarily synthesized, has been found in trace amounts in nature.
 
 
 
• **Stable vs. Radioactive Elements:**
 
 
• **​**Stable Elements: Most of the naturally occurring elements are stable, such as Hydrogen (H), Carbon (C), and Oxygen (O), forming the building blocks of life.
 
• Radioactive Elements: Some naturally occurring elements are radioactive, meaning they decay over time. Examples include Uranium (U), Radon (Rn), and Thorium (Th).

• Indigo

The area of a rectangle increases by 2 m², if its length is increased by 4 m and breadth is decreased by 2 m. If the length is decreased by 3 m and breadth is increased by 5 m, then its area increases by 23 m²​. What is the perimeter of the original rectangle (in m)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The area of a rectangle increases by 2 m² if its length is increased by 4 m and breadth is decreased by 2 m.

If the length is decreased by 3 m and the breadth is increased by 5 m, then its area increases by 23 m².

**Formula Used:**

Area of a rectangle = Length × Breadth

Perimeter of a rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

**Calculation:**

Let the original length be l meters and the original breadth be b meters.

According to the first condition:

New length = l + 4

New breadth = b - 2

New area = (l + 4) × (b - 2)

Original area = l × b

New area = Original area + 2

⇒ (l + 4)(b - 2) = lb + 2

⇒lb - 2l + 4b - 8 = lb + 2

⇒-2l + 4b - 8 = 2

⇒-2l + 4b = 10

⇒-l + 2b = 5 ...(i)

According to the second condition:

New length = l - 3

New breadth = b + 5

New area = (l - 3) × (b + 5)

Original area = l × b

New area = Original area + 23

⇒ (l - 3)(b + 5) = lb + 23

⇒lb + 5l - 3b - 15 = lb + 23

⇒5l - 3b - 15 = 23

⇒5l - 3b = 38 ...(ii)

Solving equations (i) and (ii):

From (i): -l + 2b = 5

⇒l = 2b - 5

Substitute l = 2b - 5 into (ii):

⇒5(2b - 5) - 3b = 38

⇒10b - 25 - 3b = 38

⇒7b - 25 = 38

⇒7b = 63

⇒b = 9

Now, substitute b = 9 into l = 2b - 5:

⇒l = 2(9) - 5

⇒l = 18 - 5

⇒l = 13

Perimeter of the original rectangle:

Perimeter = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

⇒Perimeter = 2 × (13 + 9)

⇒Perimeter = 2 × 22

⇒Perimeter = 44 m

**The perimeter of the original rectangle is 44 m.**

questions.question: A conference is being organised by an educational institute, where the participants will be educators of different subjects. The number of participants in physics, chemistry and mathematics are 112, 144 and 192, respectively. In each room an equal number of participants are to be seated, and all participants in a room should be educators of the same subject. What is the minimum number of rooms required during the event?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of participants in physics = 112

Number of participants in chemistry = 144

Number of participants in mathematics = 192

**Formula Used:**

To find the minimum number of rooms required, we need to determine the greatest common divisor (GCD) of the numbers of participants in each subject.

**Calculation:**

Finding the GCD of 112, 144, and 192:

Prime factorization of 112 = 2⁴ × 7

Prime factorization of 144 = 2⁴ × 3²

Prime factorization of 192 = 2⁶ × 3

Common factor = 2⁴ = 16

GCD = 16

Number of rooms for physics = 112 / 16

⇒ Number of rooms for physics = 7

Number of rooms for chemistry = 144 / 16

⇒ Number of rooms for chemistry = 9

Number of rooms for mathematics = 192 / 16

⇒ Number of rooms for mathematics = 12

Total number of rooms = 7 + 9 + 12

⇒ Total number of rooms = 28

**The minimum number of rooms required during the event is 28.**

questions.question: The least number that is exactly divisible by 24, 88 and 136 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers to be divided: 24, 88, 136

**Formula Used:**

Least number exactly divisible by given numbers = LCM (Least Common Multiple) of the numbers

**Calculation:**

Prime factorization of 24 = 2³ × 3

Prime factorization of 88 = 2³ × 11

Prime factorization of 136 = 2³ × 17

LCM = Product of highest powers of all prime factors

Highest power of 2 = 2³

Highest power of 3 = 3

Highest power of 11 = 11

Highest power of 17 = 17

LCM = 2³ × 3 × 11 × 17

⇒ LCM = 8 × 3 × 11 × 17

⇒ LCM = 24 × 11 × 17

⇒ LCM = 264 × 17

⇒ LCM = 4488

**The least number that is exactly divisible by 24, 88, and 136 is 4488.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper lists the price of a fan at 22% above its cost price and offers a 15% discount on its list price. If he earns a profit of Rs. 111, then what is the list price (in Rs.) of the fan?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (CP) of the fan = Rs. x

List price (LP) = CP + 22% of CP = 1.22 × CP

Discount offered = 15% of LP

Profit earned = Rs. 111

**Formula Used:**

Selling price (SP) = LP - Discount

Discount = 15% of LP = 0.15 × LP

Profit = SP - CP

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be Rs. x.

List price (LP) = 1.22 × x

Discount = 0.15 × 1.22 × x

Selling price (SP) = LP - Discount

SP = 1.22 × x - 0.15 × 1.22 × x

SP = 1.22 × x (1 - 0.15)

SP = 1.22 × x × 0.85

SP = 1.037 × x

Given profit = Rs. 111

Profit = SP - CP

⇒ 111 = 1.037 × x - x

⇒ 111 = 0.037 × x

⇒ x = 111 / 0.037

⇒ x ≈ 3000

List Price (LP) = 1.22 × x

LP = 1.22 × 3000

LP = 3660

**The list price of the fan is Rs. 3660.**

questions.question: A can complete a piece of work in 12 days and B can complete it in 20 days. If they work on alternate days, starting with B on first day, then in how many days will the work be finished?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can complete a piece of work in 12 days.

B can complete a piece of work in 20 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/12

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/20

**Calculation:**

Work done by B on the 1st day = 1/20

Work done by A on the 2nd day = 1/12

Work done in 2 days = 1/20 + 1/12

⇒ Work done in 2 days = (1/20) + (1/12)

⇒ Work done in 2 days = (3 + 5)/60 = 8/60 = 2/15

Work done in 2 days = 2/15

Work done in 14 days (7 cycles) = 7 × (2/15)

⇒ Work done in 14 days = 14/15

Remaining work after 14 days = 1 - 14/15

⇒ Remaining work = 1/15

B will come on 15th day and does 1/20 work.

Remaining A come and does = 1/15 - 1/20 = (4-3) / 60 = 1 /60. 

Time taken by A to complete 1/60 work = (1/60) / (1/12)

⇒ Time taken by A = 12/60

⇒ Time taken by A = 1/5 days

Total time to complete the work = 14 + 1 + 1/5 days

⇒ Total time = 15 1/5 days

 

**The work will be finished in 15 1****/****5** **days.**
